name: Siphon Wand
body:
Through your affinity for using magic wands, you have learned how to drain charges to replenish your magic.

Prerequisite(s): Craft Wand or Use Magic Device 5 ranks, Arcane pool class feature.

Benefit(s): You can drain one or more charges from a magic wand as a standard action, to replenish points of your arcane pool. You may not exceed your normal maximum number of arcane pool points.

Normal: Your arcane pool refreshes once per day when you prepare your spells.
